name: Frequency Domain Depth Cueing
definition: A method to implement depth cueing (weighting voxel intensities by distance) in FVR by convolving the 3-D Fourier transform with a combined filter G(U) in the frequency domain, avoiding the need to recompute the 3-D forward transform for every view.
summary: Frequency Domain Depth Cueing applies depth weighting in Fourier Volume Rendering via frequency domain convolution, avoiding per-view 3D transform recomputation to maintain computational efficiency.
